eightTensions.decidingFactor: Stage of work: making stays free; the release gate holds the veto.

eightTensions.poleB: Slow down because rework costs more
eightTensions.decidingFactor: Where the shortcut lands: never shortcut a shared token, foundation component, or data contract.
Computability: consistency and geometry go to code; meaning and emotional resonance stay with the eye.
Progressive disclosure: lead with one ranked recommendation (within at most three); reveal controls on demand.

eightTensions.poleA: Mock synthetic data to show the vision
eightTensions.decidingFactor: Purpose of the artefact: vision prototypes may mock the wider world; validation gates require real distributions.
Audience: show fellow builders early; show decision committees only once the experience holds together.
Reversibility: reversible in-scope work runs first and reports; irreversible, external, or spend actions wait.
Fallback safety: reroute to a verified sibling if within error budget; hard-stop when safety or data boundaries trip.

fiveUnwrittenRules.name: Confirmation over blank-slate onboarding
fiveUnwrittenRules.prompt: Onboarding confirms what the system can already responsibly infer, clearly separating given facts from guesses.

fiveUnwrittenRules.name: One ranked recommendation (max three)
fiveUnwrittenRules.prompt: Surface one recommended next move with its reason, bounded within at most three options.

fiveUnwrittenRules.name: Run reversible work ahead, validate at the boundary
fiveUnwrittenRules.prompt: Agents execute reversible preparation before asking, and pause at the irreversible boundary.

fiveUnwrittenRules.name: Agent transport failures belong to the system
fiveUnwrittenRules.prompt: A failed model or tool call is absorbed or clearly owned by the system, never dumped on the user as raw jargon.

fiveUnwrittenRules.name: Collapsed threads preserve an honest trace
fiveUnwrittenRules.prompt: Collapsing background agent work keeps a plain one-line record of what changed and why.
